adjudication.rationale: In packages/core/EventManager.ts, the error handler was changed from always returning a single `success: false` result to returning `calendarReference?.map(...) ?? []`. Since `calendarReference` is initialized as `undefined` and only assigned inside the `try`, any exception thrown before it’s assigned will now produce `[]`. This is indistinguishable from the earlier `if (calendarReference.length === 0) return [];` “nothing to update” path, and can silently mask real failures that previously surfaced as an explicit failure result.
